caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped container with a lid, likely a box or tin, decorated with a nature scene. The main scene on the side of the container features two squirrels, both colored in shades of grey with red-pink outlining and detailing. One squirrel is sitting upright while the other is crouched on all fours facing the first squirrel. The background consists of trees and foliage, rendered in shades of yellow, brown, and green. The top of the container also features painted foliage in similar colors, with greens, browns, and hints of purple. The overall color palette includes yellows, browns, greens, light grey, pinkish red, and cream. The scene wraps around the curved surface of the container, with the squirrels forming the focal point in the foreground and the flora filling the background. The style uses fine outlines and stippled texture to define the animals and vegetation.
title: Bandbox
